verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch ships official Docker-based local self-hosting (curl start-local, Docker one-liner) and this was independently verified in the probe: a full Elasticsearch 9.5.3 instance was booted locally in Docker with security disabled, indexed a document, and returned a real BM25 search result — a genuine self-hosted engine roundtrip. Community evidence confirms self-hosting is common practice (e.g., Elastic Cloud on K8s) though some basic security/alerting features were historically paywalled in self-managed deployments. Missing for 10: independent confirmation that all AI-relevant features (vector search, semantic_text) work identically in self-hosted vs cloud, and clarity on current licensing of security features in self-hosted mode.
